caption: The drawing depicts a single, ornate brass andiron with a golden-yellow color, prominently centered within a rectangular frame set against a lightly shaded beige background. The andiron features a decorative top finial with a teardrop-shaped tip, followed by a series of bulbous, vertically ribbed sections that taper downward. The base transitions into a rectangular plinth, from which three curved legs extend outward, each ending in a rounded, paw-like foot. A rigid, rectangular projection emerges from the back of the plinth, casting a shadow to the left side of the image. The artist's name, "Hans Korsch," appears in small print in the lower left corner of the border surrounding the drawing.
title: Andiron
